notes: Crew call and wrap are now times you can state on a job, under the event times. They were only ever worked out before - rig time back from the start, pack-down forward from the end - and on KI/KI that guessed 11:00 and 03:00 against your real 14:00 and 04:00, which also put the on-site total at 16 hours instead of 14. State either and the quote, confirmation and crew email print Call 14:00 - Show 18:30-02:00 - Wrap 04:00 instead of one range, and the hours in the fee are measured between them. Leave both blank and nothing changes. New per-job option to state an overtime rate on the quote, off by default: a percentage of each crew member's own day rate, charged per hour in half-hour blocks or per half hour, counting from the wrap. The production fee now names what it was actually charged on, so a job with nothing rebilled reads crew & hire rather than crew, hire & logistics.
